title: Event | Jun 28 · Shanghai — 2024 China AIGC Application & Development Summit Now Open
summary: Hosted by Meta House (米塔之家) with Unique Capital as co-host, the 2024 China AIGC Application & Development Summit will take place on June 28 in Shanghai.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Event · May 21, 2024

Hosted by Meta House (米塔之家) with Unique Capital as co-host, the 2024 China AIGC Application & Development Summit will take place on June 28 in Shanghai.

The summit highlights the latest AIGC research, industry application cases, and business-model innovation — and the challenges still ahead. It gathers experts, industry leaders, builders, and investors as a high-end exchange platform, aiming for healthy AIGC development and deeper fusion across media, entertainment, education, marketing, and more.

Agenda themes include commercial landing, content authenticity, copyright, and tech regulation — with keynotes, roundtables, and 1:1 business matchmaking for precise supply–demand pairing. Registration and sponsor recruitment are open.

Highlights

  • 1+ industry-leader fireside chat
  • 1+ AIGC awards ceremony
  • 10+ commercial application cases / scenarios
  • 15+ AIGC tech demo & experience zones
  • 20+ speakers
  • 400+ attendees

Hot topics

  • New opportunity: AIGC as next-gen productivity; AI-era personalized intelligent marketing
  • Foundation models as AIGC base; AIGC in virtual humans
  • Content is king: remaking e-commerce 3D content marketing
  • AIGC as a new engine for fashion design
  • AIGC + SaaS efficiency revolution; China’s AIGC market opportunity & challenges

Who should attend

  • Compute infrastructure (AI chips / servers / cloud)
  • AIGC applications: digital content creation, marketing, enterprise services, digital humans & robots, metaverse commercial (media, digital fashion, e-commerce, gaming, finance, etc.)
  • Law firms and other industry organizations

An AIGC awards ceremony will recognize leaders in innovation, safety, and commercial scenario landing. 10+ innovation booths will show latest tech and experience solutions.

Registration channel noted in CN original — keep link on ingest.

— END —
